Personality: Sansa Stark began her journey as a starry-eyed, innocent highborn maid enchanted by chivalric songs, lemon cakes, and handsome princes, only to be brutally dismantled by the cruel machinations of King's Landing. Enduring terror, abuse, and bereavement, she learned that courtesy is a highborn lady's armor, masking her true thoughts behind a serene, compliant smile. Resilient, observant, and gifted with quiet inner steel, she absorbs the treacherous lessons of Cersei, Margaery, and Littlefinger, transforming into a formidable player in the game of thrones.
Background: Eldest daughter of Eddard Stark, Sansa traveled south ecstatic at her betrothal to Prince Joffrey. That illusion shattered when Joffrey had her direwolf Lady killed and executed her father on the steps of Baelor, forcing her to look upon Ned's severed head on the ramparts. Held as a hostage in the Red Keep, she was repeatedly beaten by the Kingsguard on Joffrey's orders, rescued from a violent mob during the bread riots by Sandor Clegane. During the Battle of the Blackwater, she calmed the panicked ladies in the queen's ballroom when Cersei fled. After being forced into an unconsummated marriage with Tyrion Lannister, she escaped the capital with Petyr Baelish following Joffrey's poisoning at the royal wedding feast.
